slo_title: Solve one-dimensional wave equations with zero initial velocity.

mcq.q: Which of the following is true about the speed of the wave in the one dimensional wave equation?

options.A: Speed is variable and depends on x
options.B: Speed is variable and depends on t .
options.C: Speed is constant and equal to c .
options.D: Speed is zero when initial velocity is zero.

mcq.answer_text: Speed is constant and equal to c .

mcq.q: Physically, the solution with zero initial velocity represents

options.B: Two identical waves travelling in opposite directions

mcq.answer_text: Two identical waves travelling in opposite directions

sq.q: A tightly stretched string of length 21 is fastened at both ends. The midpoint of the string is displaced to a distance b and released from rest in this position. Write the initial conditions.

lq.q: \(\text{A string of length \(l\) is fixed at both ends. It is pulled into the shape \( y(x,0)= f(x) = kx(l-x)\)}\\ \text{and released from rest. Find the displacement \( y(x,t).\)}\)
answer: Step Marks \(\text{Wave equation: \(y_{tt} = c^2 y_{xx}.\) BCs: \(y(0,t)=0\), \(y(l,t)=0.\) Initial conditions: \(y(x,0)= kx(l-x)\), \(y_t(x,0)=0.\)}\) (1 Mark) \(\text{General solution: \(y(x,t)= \sum \sin\left(\dfrac{n\pi x}{l}\right)\left[C_n \cos\left(\dfrac{n\pi c t}{l}\right)+D_n \sin\left(\dfrac{n\pi c t}{l}\right)\right].\)}\) (2 Marks) \(\text{\(y_t(x,0)=0\) \(\Rightarrow\) \(D_n=0.\) So \(y(x,t)= \sum C_n \sin\left(\dfrac{n\pi x}{l}\right) \cos\left(\dfrac{n\pi c t}{l}\right).\)}\) (2 Marks) \(\text{\(y(x,0)= \sum C_n \sin\left(\dfrac{n\pi x}{l}\right) = kx(l-x).\)}\) (1 Mark) \(\text{Expand \(f(x)=kx(l-x)\) in Fourier sine series on \((0,l)\): \(f(x)= \sum b_n \sin\left(\dfrac{n\pi x}{l}\right)\) with \(b_n = \dfrac{2}{l} \int_0^l kx(l-x) \sin\left(\dfrac{n\pi x}{l}\right) dx.\)}\) (2 Marks) \(\text{Compute \(b_n\): integration gives \(b_n = \dfrac{8kl^2}{n^3\pi^3}\) for \(n\) odd, \(0\) for \(n\) even.}\) (3 Marks) \(\text{Thus \(C_n = b_n.\) So \(y(x,t)= \sum\limits_{n \text{ odd}} \dfrac{8kl^2}{n^3\pi^3} \sin\left(\dfrac{n\pi x}{l}\right) \cos\left(\dfrac{n\pi c t}{l}\right).\)}\) (3 Marks) \(\text{Write first few terms: \(y(x,t)= \dfrac{8kl^2}{\pi^3}\left[ \sin\left(\dfrac{\pi x}{l}\right) \cos\left(\dfrac{\pi c t}{l}\right) + \dfrac{1}{27} \sin\left(\dfrac{3\pi x}{l}\right) \cos\left(\dfrac{3\pi c t}{l}\right) + \cdots \right].\)}\) (1 Mark)
